[image: Ending Reckless Foreign Wars illustration] Ending Reckless Foreign Wars War should be a last resort, not a default tool of foreign policy. Lydia will oppose open-ended military commitments without a clear objective or exit plan, redirect wasted conflict spending to domestic priorities, and restore real diplomacy as the first response, not a box to check before military action already planned. [image: Ending U.S. Complicity in Gaza illustration] Ending U.S. Complicity in Gaza Independent UN experts, genocide scholars, and human rights organizations, including Israeli ones, have concluded Israel has committed genocidal acts in Gaza. Lydia would vote against continued military aid until compliance is independently verified, and will push to enforce existing human rights law, force a real congressional vote on arms sales, and oppose merging U.S. and Israeli military supply chains. [image: Restoring Congress's War Power illustration] Restoring Congress's War Power The Constitution gives the power to declare war to Congress, not the President. Lydia will vote for binding resolutions to end unauthorized hostilities, oppose treating old AUMFs as permanent justification for new conflicts, and push Congress to reclaim its constitutional role regardless of who holds the presidency.
